subject: MAP checkpoint: evidence cadence and pen-test scope alignment
messages:

Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-10-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Draft MAP and pen-test window

Chloe / team,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. Attached is our initial MAP spreadsheet with security asks highlighted. Two priority items for us to lock down this week:

1) SOC 2 evidence owners and expected delivery windows (e.g., config screenshots, policy docs, attestation evidence).
2) Pen-test scope & preferred testing window (we're targeting late Nov but need your confirmation on scope and any IP/ingress constraints).

Can you confirm: who at Redwood will own the SOC 2 evidence collection, who will be the technical contact for the pen test, and whether audit logs for customer data can be exported in CSV for sharing with our auditors?

I copied Kar (karthik) since he was on the call and can help with technical constraints.

Attachments: ACME_MAP_Draft.xlsx (MAP draft; tab: security_asks)

Next steps: propose 30–40m sync this week to assign owners and firm a pen-test window.

Thanks,
Tom Evans
Director, IT Security
ACME Corp

Tom — thanks for the MAP and for calling this out. Short answers up front:

- SOC 2 evidence owner (initial): chloe_martin (point) + karthik_iyer (technical lead)
- Pen test technical contact: karthik_iyer
- Audit log export: yes — we can provide a redacted CSV export of request/response metadata; retention and redaction rules are noted below.

I pulled a quick evidence index and attached it (redwood_evidence_index.csv) — it maps MAP line items to our internal artifact names and approximate delivery ETA. High-level action items below (I'll propose owners in the shared MAP doc):

Action items from my side:
- A1: Populate delivery ETA for: 1.1 (config screenshots), 1.3 (dataflow diagram) — owner: chloe_martin — due: 2028-10-27
- A2: Confirm log export fields and redaction plan — owner: karthik_iyer — due: 2028-10-25
- A3: Draft pen-test scope addendum (what we expose to test infra) — owner: karthik_iyer + security reviewer mina_haddad — due: 2028-10-30

Proposed sync: Thu 2028-10-26 09:30 PT — 30m — to run through owners and confirm pen-test window. If that works, I'll send a calendar invite.

Notes on audit logs: we store request metadata (timestamp, model_id, route, token_counts) for 90 days by default; customers on enterprise plans can request longer retention and bulk export. We will provide guidance on redaction of any PII prior to export.

Attachments: redwood_evidence_index.csv (CSV, 45 rows)

Thanks — Chloe

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: chloe_martin <chloe_martin@redwood.ai>, Tom Evans <tevans@acme.com>
Cc: mina_haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-10-24T14:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP and pen-test window — technical clarifications

Tom / Chloe — quick technical notes to clarify what we can commit to for the MAP and pen test: 

- Audit logs: we can export a CSV with the following columns: timestamp, request_id, model_variant, prompt_token_count, completion_token_count, route_id. We will not export raw prompts by default; if ACME needs prompt-level data for their audit, we’ll require a separate data-access agreement and a scoped export with PII redaction handled by your security team.

- Pen-test constraints:
  * We can accept active external testing against our dedicated staging endpoint (shared VPC) during an agreed window.
  * We do not allow fuzzing of model weights or attempts to extract proprietary kernel/artifacts — this will be marked out-of-scope.
  * We will provide a list of internal IPs and an SSH-jump host for limited access if needed.

- Owners:
  * Evidence collection (screenshots, policy PDFs): chloe_martin (owner)
  * Runtime/log export & pen-test technical coordination: karthik_iyer (technical contact)
  * Security review / pen-test acceptance: mina_haddad (security reviewer)

I’ll draft the pen-test scope addendum and drop it in the shared Drive; Chloe, can you confirm the Thu sync?

— Kar
Karthik Iyer | Staff Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

Attendees: Tom Evans (ACME), Chloe Martin (Redwood), Karthik Iyer (Redwood), Mina Haddad (Redwood)

Summary: Reviewed MAP security asks; agreed evidence mapping and pen-test constraints. ACME to confirm proposed pen-test window (prefers Nov 20–24). Redwood agreed to deliver most evidence artifacts by end of Oct and to provide a redacted audit-log export for review.

Action items (owners + agreed due dates):

- Pen-test window currently tentative; if ACME requires earlier testing we may need to prioritize isolated staging allocation.

I'll follow up with the Drive link to the scope addendum and a short checklist for the auditors.
